Notes

  • All three of these are JAGG's own copy, taken from posts the previous vendor ran and rewritten for November and the current offer. They are not new ideas being tested on you.

  • These three posts have no town in the greeting. That is deliberate. Week one opens with "Hey East Patchogue" and the like, which has to be swapped for every group. These do not, so there is nothing to get wrong.
